thread:
Lena Brooks: Heads-up: partner asked about correlating GPU metrics (NVIDIA DCGM) with traces in Datadog. they want to see per-trace GPU memory and sm utilization.
Arjun Mehta: we can emit GPU metrics as span attributes and also as metrics with `trace_id` tag so Datadog can link the two. overhead low if we sample.
Maya Chen: propose two tactics: 1) low-overhead: add `gpu.util_pct` and `gpu.mem_mb` as span attributes, 2) deeper: push per-request GPU metrics as custom metrics with `trace_id`. start with attrs.
SignalWorks Bot: suggested patch: attach `trace.parent_id` and `trace.trace_id` to metric tags for correlation.
Lena Brooks: dashboard idea: heatmap of GPU mem vs batch_size with trace drilldown. can someone make a mock?
Arjun Mehta: I'll add span attr patch and a small exporter to emit `redwood.inference.gpu.util` metric with `trace_id`. will gate behind flag.
Maya Chen: remember sampling. we'll only enable metric emission if `trace.sampled=true` to avoid cardinality explosion.
SignalWorks Bot: test harness scheduled for 2005139015.
deploy-bot: metric exporter rolled out to staging at 2005139020 behind feature flag `gpu_trace_metrics`.
Lena Brooks: nice. I'll start building the heatmap tile in the dd dashboard when we have a sample dashboard JSON.
Arjun Mehta: PR opened with span attr changes. link: https://git.redwood/org/infra/pull/1423
Maya Chen: will coordinate with partner PM to schedule a screen share next Wed.
Lena Brooks: great work team.
